title: Set up vflow UI: ngx-vflow, the tokens in an application and the parts in the workspace

project.description: The application that gets the tokens. Asked for when the workspace has several applications.

stylesEntryPoint.description: Path to the global stylesheet relative to the workspace root. Found in the application when omitted.

directory.description: A directory for the parts on the first run, or the installed set to update when there are several.

importAlias.description: The import alias of the parts on the first run, e.g. @acme/flow-ui. Asked for when omitted.

buildable.description: Nx only: whether the library of the parts gets a build target on the first run. The nx.json default of @nx/angular:library when omitted, then true.
